subject.title: Review path for an AIPOU MCP receipt skill with explicit no-hidden-wallet-action rules

question: Should ClawHub define an AIPOU-specific review path now, defer it to the broader vetted-community plugin and crypto/content-policy RFCs, or reject wallet/settlement-capable package recommendation for now?
rationale: The issue asks for security and product policy around wallet-capable MCP behavior and metadata placement, and current main has no maintainer-approved rule that automation can safely infer.

options.title: Defer to broader policy RFCs
options.body: Use the vetted-community plugin and content-policy threads as the canonical place to decide wallet-capable package review requirements before answering AIPOU specifically.

options.title: Pilot a narrow AIPOU checklist
options.body: Define a temporary source-linked, local-receipt-only review checklist with explicit proof and no-hidden-wallet-action requirements while marking claim/payment mode as out of scope.

options.title: Reject recommendation for now
options.body: State that wallet, settlement, token, or reward-capable packages should not be listed or recommended until ClawHub has a published policy for those categories.

recommendation.title: Defer to broader policy RFCs
recommendation.body: Use the vetted-community plugin and content-policy threads as the canonical place to decide wallet-capable package review requirements before answering AIPOU specifically.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the named CODEOWNERS security reviewer for the affected trust and package-policy surfaces and have recent authorship on the relevant docs/schema.
